headlines.description: — Boston goaltender Linus Ullmark raised his arms in jubilation when the final buzzer sounded and the party was complete for the sellout crowd at Fenway Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeBrusk scores 2 in 3rd, Bruins beat Pens in Winter Classic

name: Vegas Golden Knights at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Nicolas Roy scored twice in the second period, Mark Stone extended his road point streak to a franchise-record eight games and the Vegas Golden Knights held off the banged-up Colorado Avalanche 3-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roy scores twice, Knights hold off banged-up Avalanche 3-2

headlines.description: — Travis Konecny and Joel Farabee each had a goal and an assist and Philadelphia Flyers beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-1 Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konecny, Farabee lead Flyers to 4-1 win over Ducks
